idea: Row re-gridding with free count bumps: in a k-row layout, rows with k+j squares of side 1/(k+j) are always height-feasible alongside rows of k squares of side 1/k, and leave a residual horizontal strip of height Σ(1/k − 1/(k+j)). Enumerate row-count vectors and fill that residual strip with a row of tiny squares, plus LP compaction, to reach counts that neither the grid nor the Erdős–Soifer family reaches.
